 "rationale": "The core gives I=UT ln8/R1 at 0.4 uA. The output leg feeds the scaled sum vref=k(Veb3+I R2) with k=R3/(R2+R3)~0.6, so the PTAT term largely cancels the Veb slope near 0.66 V. Supply current is about 3x0.4 uA plus a small start-up current, roughly 1.3 uA and 2.4 uW. Long-L weak-inversion PMOS plus a gate-to-VDD cap give >40 dB PSRR. Headroom is fine at 1.6 V."}

PARAMS = {
    "I":    (0.4e-6, 0.2e-6, 0.8e-6),   # core branch / output current
    "VP":   (0.50, 0.40, 0.60),         # PTAT voltage I*R2 at 27C
    "a":    (0.75, 0.68, 0.90),         # I*R3 (sets k and Q3 current)
    "Lp":   (4.0, 1.0, 8.0),            # PMOS mirror length
    "Ln":   (2.0, 1.0, 6.0),            # NMOS level-shift length
    "gmp":  (14.0, 8.0, 16.0),          # PMOS gm/Id
    "gmn":  (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),         # NMOS gm/Id
    "Cg":   (1e-12, 0.2e-12, 3e-12),    # PMOS gate-to-vdd cap (PSRR / stability)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = p["I"]; N = 8
    R1 = UT * math.log(N) / I
    R2 = p["VP"] / I
    R3 = p["a"] / I

    # NMOS level-shift pair (equal size): M1 diode sits on Q1, M2 on R1+Q2
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmn"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.45)
    # PMOS mirror: M4 diode (nb), M3 -> na, M5 -> output leg
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.8)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # core
    n.dev("M3", "na", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "nb", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M1", "na", "na", "e1", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("M2", "nb", "na", "x2", "vss", mn)
    n.R("R1", "x2", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=N)
    # output leg: vref = R3/(R2+R3) * (Veb3 + I*R2)
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.R("R3", "vref", "vss", R3)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    n.C("CG", "nb", "vdd", p["Cg"])
    # start-up: sx high while vref low -> MS pulls nb down / injects into na
    n.M("MS2", "sx", "vref", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MS3", "sx", "na", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)
    n.M("MS", "nb", "sx", "na", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 0.5)
    n.C("CS", "sx", "vss", 50e-15)

    # predictions
    veb = lambda i: 0.76 + UT * math.log(max(i, 1e-12) / 10e-6)
    iq3 = 0.1 * I; v3 = veb(iq3)
    for _ in range(20):
        iq3 = max((I * R3 - v3) / (R2 + R3), 1e-9); v3 = veb(iq3)
    k = R3 / (R2 + R3)
    vref = k * (v3 + I * R2)
    slope = k * (-1.85e-3 + I * R2 / 300.15)          # V/C
    tc = abs(slope) * 165 / vref / 165 * 1e6 + 150      # + curvature allowance
    gds_out = mp.gds
    dv = gds_out * 1.0 * (R2 * R3 / (R2 + R3)) * 2      # core + output leg
    line = dv
    psrr = -db(max(dv, 1e-6))
    power = 1.8 * (3 * I + 0.03e-6)
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "line_reg": line,
               "power": power, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
